items.title: 13.11 Use of chlorine in water purification (pani saaf karne mein chlorine) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 13.11, printed page 301.

blocks.text: Chlorine gas bohat poisonous (zehreeli) hai. Lekin thori amount (miqdar) mein yeh insanon ke liye harmless (nuqsan na dene wali) hai, jab ke bimariyan phailane wale bacteria ke liye poisonous hai. Apni strong disinfectant (jaraseem maarne wali) properties ki wajah se chlorine pani saaf karne ke treatment plants mein bohat istemal hoti hai. Is tareeqe mein chlorine pani mein dali jati hai, jahan yeh active species (asal kaam karne wale hisse) banati hai jo bacteria aur doosre pathogens (bimari phailane wale jaraseem) ko maar deti hain. Swimming pools ka pani bhi thori zyada concentration ki chlorine se chlorinate kiya jata hai, kyun ke us mein bacteria zyada hone ka chance hota hai. Primary (asal) active species chloric (I) acid ya hypochlorous acid (HOCl) aur chlorate (I) ya hypochlorite ion (OCl⁻) hain. Chlorination pani ko jaraseem se paak karne ka relatively (muqable mein) sasta tareeqa hai.

blocks.caption: Chlorination ek nazar mein

blocks.prompt: Pani saaf karne mein chlorine istemal karne ka ek nuqsan batayein.
blocks.explanation: Chlorine pani mein maujood organic substances (cheezon) se react kar ke chlorinated by-products (jaise trihalomethanes) bana sakti hai, jin mein se kuch sehat ke liye harmful (nuqsan-deh) samjhe jate hain; pani ka zaiqa aur boo bhi badal sakti hai. Chlorine gas khud zehreeli hai, is liye ise dhyan se rakhna aur istemal karna parta hai.

items: Thori chlorine insanon ke liye be-zarar magar bacteria ke liye poisonous; pani saaf karne ka sasta tareeqa.
Active species: HOCl aur OCl⁻; swimming pools mein zyada amount.
